To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1. Knowledge-based learning is an effective way to induce rules from incomplete domain theories.
the knowledge-based learning system can induce a set of rules that are more accurate and fewer in number than those induced by a rule induction system.

knowledge-based learning systems are more effective at inducing knowledge than rule-based learning systems, and knowledge-based learning systems that use domain knowledge to select examples are more effective at learning knowledge than knowledge-based learning systems which use all examples.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how domain knowledge affects rule learning.
how to use domain knowledge to improve knowledge-based learning systems.
the problem of knowledge acquisition for expert systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
domain knowledge improves knowledge-based learning systems.
domain knowledge is an effective means of guiding knowledge acquisition.

the results show that domain knowledge is an important component of knowledge-based learning and that it is possible to improve the quality of the knowledge-based learning systems using domain knowledge.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the use of domain knowledge in knowledge-based learning is effective in inducing knowledge missing in a domain knowledge base, but it can be difficult to determine the best subset of examples to select.
domain knowledge can be used to improve the performance of knowledge-based learning systems.

the use of knowledge-based learning is a promising technique that is able to produce more accurate rules and more accurate theories than rule induction using all provided examples, and it can be applied in many domains where domain knowledge is available.
The main takeaway from our work is that
knowledge-based learning is more effective than rule-based learning.
domain knowledge can improve knowledge-based learning.
the knowledge-based learning approach is a useful way of improving learning systems.
